transcript.content: Hi, welcome in. Before we get started, can you tell me what brings you in to see me today?
My eating has gotten really off. Some days before a shift, I barely have coffee and a granola bar, and that’s it. My scrubs have been hanging loose lately, and I’m not trying to lose weight.

When you're eating less like this, is it because you're consciously trying to avoid gaining weight or worried about your body shape, or does it feel more like you just don't have an appetite or don't have time to eat?

No, I’m not trying to lose weight or avoid gaining it. I just… don’t seem to be eating much. Before work it’ll be coffee and maybe a granola bar, and then the day gets going. My scrubs are loose now, which worries me because I wasn’t trying for that.
Over the past few weeks, have you been feeling noticeably down, sad, or having little interest or pleasure in things you'd normally enjoy?
Yeah. Most mornings I wake up with this heavy, hollow feeling, like the day’s already ruined before I even put on my badge.
Have you noticed any physical symptoms like your heart racing, feeling unusually hot or sweaty, or your hands trembling, even when you're not exerting yourself?
I haven’t really noticed anything like that. No, not that I can think of.
Has this heavy, hollow feeling and loss of interest in things been present nearly every day for the past two weeks or longer?
Yeah. It’s been most mornings for at least the last couple of weeks. I wake up feeling heavy and hollow, like the day is already ruined before I even get to work.
Aside from feeling heavy and hollow in the mornings, have you noticed a loss of interest or enjoyment in things you used to like doing, such as hobbies or spending time with friends?
Yeah. I used to run in Van Cortlandt Park, take photos, play chess with friends. Now I mostly just think, “What’s the point?” and stay home scrolling or checking my budget spreadsheet.
Have you been feeling unusually tired or low on energy nearly every day, even when you haven't been especially active?
Yeah. Even after a full night in bed, I feel like I’ve just worked a double shift. By lunchtime I’m really fighting to keep my thoughts together.
Have you had any thoughts of hurting yourself or feeling like you'd be better off not being here?
I haven’t made any plan to hurt myself. But… yeah, I do catch myself wishing I just wouldn’t wake up sometimes, or thinking it might be easier if I just disappeared.

Have you ever had a period, lasting several days or more, where you felt unusually energetic, elated, or needed much less sleep than usual, along with feeling like your thoughts were racing or you were unusually confident?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really noticed a stretch where I felt especially energetic or like I needed much less sleep.

Has this been affecting your ability to function at work or keep up with your daily responsibilities—for example, missing shifts, struggling to concentrate on tasks, or needing help from others to get through the day?

Yeah. I’ve been making mistakes at work that I normally wouldn’t, and sometimes I need coworkers to repeat really simple requests. I’ve also stopped going to chess nights and photography walks—I don’t trust myself to keep up or act normal around people.
